import hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('replication/phase2/PHASE2_FROZEN_MANIFEST.json')
m=json.loads(p.read_text())
print('manifest_sha256',hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print('keys',list(m))
print('file_count',len(m['files']))
errors=[]
for item in m['files']:
 f=p.parent/item['path']
 if not f.is_file(): errors.append({'path':item['path'],'error':'missing'}); continue
 data=f.read_bytes(); h=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
 if len(data)!=item['bytes'] or h!=item['sha256']: errors.append({'path':item['path'],'expected_sha256':item['sha256'],'observed_sha256':h,'expected_bytes':item['bytes'],'observed_bytes':len(data)})
expected={x['path'] for x in m['files']}
actual={str(x.relative_to(p.parent)) for x in p.parent.rglob('*') if x.is_file() and x!=p}
print('errors',json.dumps(errors,indent=2))
print('extras',sorted(actual-expected)); print('missing_inventory',sorted(expected-actual))
for k,v in m.items():
 if k!='files': print(k, str(v)[:1800])
